summary: AWS deploy prep: moves the static-files/catch-all index.html handler after the /api routers (before, every GET to /api/* such as email activation was swallowed and returned index.html), adds a public GET /api/user/status health check returning {message:'Ok'}, gitignores ECS task JSON.

statements.why: Health route is public but returns only {message:'Ok'}; no login/payment/db/secret problem.

statements.text: New server code that lists data and works without logging in. /api/user/status
statements.why: Public is correct (no checkAuth), but it lists no data, only returns {message:'Ok'}; owner may think user data is exposed.

misses.what: Before this commit the catch-all app.get('*') sat before the API routers, so every GET API request (e.g. email activation link /api/user/email/activate/:token) returned the React index.html; app.js reorder fixes that. Card doesn't mention app.js.
